_README: USD per MILLION tokens, keyed by exact model id or exact id plus a dated suffix -YYYYMMDD (model_agent4.model_key_matches; an exact key wins). claude-fable-5 therefore does not match claude-fable-5.1 ids. run4.py and preflight.py refuse real (non --dry-run) runs while a model in the grid has confirmed=false. Anthropic spend is computed from these numbers (input = uncached input tokens; cache_write = 5-minute cache-creation tokens; cache_read = cache-hit tokens). OpenRouter spend uses the usage.cost OpenRouter reports per response; OpenRouter entries here are used only for the pre-episode cost estimate and as a fallback if usage.cost is missing.

claude-haiku-4-5._note: Confirmed 2026-10-31 against Anthropic's published Haiku 4.5 price ($1/$5 per MTok).

openrouter:qwen/qwen3.6-27b._note: Spend is taken from OpenRouter's reported usage.cost per call; these numbers are only the pre-episode estimate/fallback (third-party tracker, 2026-10-29).

claude-sonnet-5._note: Confirmed: Anthropic pricing page platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing, checked 2026-10-31 ($2 input / $10 output / $2.50 5m cache write / $0.20 cache hit per MTok).

claude-fable-5._note: Confirmed: Anthropic pricing page platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing, checked 2026-10-31 ($10 / $50 / $12.50 / $1 per MTok). This entry matches claude-fable-5 and claude-fable-5-YYYYMMDD only, never claude-fable-5.1 ids (exact/dated-prefix matching, tested).
